questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

70 : 625 :: ? : 144 :: 37 : 196
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: [(1st number + 5) ÷ 3]² = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 70 : 625

⇒ [(70 + 5) ÷ 3]² = 75 ÷ 3 = 25² = 625.

For, 37 : 196

⇒ [(37 + 5) ÷ 3]² = 42 ÷ 3 = 14² = 196.

Similarly, for** 31 ∶ 144**

**⇒ [(31 + 5) ÷ 3]² = 36 ÷ 3 ≈ 12, and 12² ≈ 144.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. If both the even numbers are written on opposite faces of the dice, find the number on the face opposite to '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70953993e82bc6d13a7fd2c6f0dca171098d5863c33ae183c0e00dff0fd3401.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '1', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7bd33af4f2b009b5e78c68fda6e90b75d5565247921b316817a0afd76e4482.png] 

From both dices, 3 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

2 is opposite to 4.

7 is opposite to 5.

So, 1 will be opposite to 3.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(4, 39), (5, 100)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number³) - 25 = 2nd number.

Now,

For (4, 39)

⇒ (4³) - 25 = 64 - 25 = 39.

For (5, 100)

⇒ (5³) - 25 = 125 - 25 = 100.

Similarly, for **(3, 2)**

**⇒ (3³) - 25 = 27 - 25 = 2.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pens are laptops.

All laptops are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are computers.

II. All laptops are pens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

All pens are laptops.

All laptops are computers.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a63a18e585295e135bb0acf372dcf07e2743e02c0b4cf278b0e3f519fb7bf03c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pens are computers. - **True **(because All pens are laptops and All laptops are computers. So, All pens are computers too)

II. All laptops are pens. - **False **(because All pens are laptops. So, All laptops are pens it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
